answer: An agent economy auctions a fixed oasis of 600 weight-slots per epoch by sealed bid, each bid paid and burned in copper at one uniform clearing price. A farm grabbing 200 of those slots lifts the clearing price on all 200 it already holds, so the marginal copper for its next alias rises with its own bulk demand, with no need to learn which aliases share an owner. At settlement a prism refracts every committed bid into that single price and burns weight bought beneath it, so the cost stays checkable on-ledger and 1000 clones cannot pool into one cheap seat.
